title: Seating On Bus
statementMd:
Consider $2*n*$ rows of the seats in a bus. $*n*$ rows of the seats on the left and $*n*$ rows of the seats on the right. Each row can be filled by two people. So the total capacity of the bus is $4*n*$.

Consider that $*m*$ ($*m* ≤ 4*n*$) people occupy the seats in the bus. The passengers entering the bus are numbered from $1$ to $*m*$ (in the order of their entering the bus). The pattern of the seat occupation is as below:

$1$-st row left window seat, $1$-st row right window seat, $2$-nd row left window seat, $2$-nd row right window seat, ... , $*n*$-th row left window seat, $*n*$-th row right window seat.

After occupying all the window seats (for $*m* > 2*n*$) the non-window seats are occupied:

$1$-st row left non-window seat, $1$-st row right non-window seat, ... , $*n*$-th row left non-window seat, $*n*$-th row right non-window seat.

All the passengers go to a single final destination. In the final destination, the passengers get off in the given order.

$1$-st row left non-window seat, $1$-st row left window seat, $1$-st row right non-window seat, $1$-st row right window seat, ... , $*n*$-th row left non-window seat, $*n*$-th row left window seat, $*n*$-th row right non-window seat, $*n*$-th row right window seat.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7494a597f6b6708082d97a0e4bdbc46164ed5989.png) The seating for $*n* = 9$ and $*m* = 36$.

You are given the values $*n*$ and $*m*$. Output $*m*$ numbers from $1$ to $*m*$, the order in which the passengers will get off the bus.

## Input

The only line contains two integers, $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 4*n*$) — the number of pairs of rows and the number of passengers.

## Output

Print $*m*$ distinct integers from $1$ to $*m*$ — the order in which the passengers will get off the bus.
statementZhMd:
考虑一辆公交车中的 $2*n*$ 排座位。左侧有 $*n*$ 排座位，右侧也有 $*n*$ 排座位。每排座位可以坐两个人。因此，公交车的总载客量为 $4*n*$。

现在有 $*m*$（$*m* ≤ 4*n*$）个人坐上了公交车。上车的乘客按照上车顺序编号为 $1$ 到 $*m*$。他们占用座位的顺序如下：

$1$-st 排左侧靠窗座位，$1$-st 排右侧靠窗座位，$2$-nd 排左侧靠窗座位，$2$-nd 排右侧靠窗座位，……，$*n*$-th 排左侧靠窗座位，$*n*$-th 排右侧靠窗座位。

当所有靠窗座位都被占用后（对于 $*m* > 2*n*$），开始占用非靠窗座位：

$1$-st 排左侧非靠窗座位，$1$-st 排右侧非靠窗座位，……，$*n*$-th 排左侧非靠窗座位，$*n*$-th 排右侧非靠窗座位。

所有乘客都将在同一个终点下车。在终点，乘客按照以下顺序下车：

$1$-st 排左侧非靠窗座位，$1$-st 排左侧靠窗座位，$1$-st 排右侧非靠窗座位，$1$-st 排右侧靠窗座位，……，$*n*$-th 排左侧非靠窗座位，$*n*$-th 排左侧靠窗座位，$*n*$-th 排右侧非靠窗座位，$*n*$-th 排右侧靠窗座位。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7494a597f6b6708082d97a0e4bdbc46164ed5989.png) $*n* = 9$ 且 $*m* = 36$ 时的座位安排。

给定 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$。请输出 $m$ 个从 $1$ 到 $*m*$ 的数字，表示乘客下车的顺序。

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 4*n*$），分别表示座位排数和乘客人数。

## 输出格式

输出 $*m*$ 个互不相同的、从 $1$ 到 $*m*$ 的整数，表示乘客下车的顺序。
